title: (Pwn2Own) QNAP TS-464 Cloud Utility Command Injection Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of QNAP TS-464 NAS devices. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the handling of password reset requests. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of a user-supplied string before using it to execute a system call. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of root.
